Impact timed from the impact sound. Soun.en: Impact timed from the impact sound. Sound travel adds about 3 ms per metre between you and the iPhone.
Impact timed from the impact sound. Soun.ko: 임팩트 시점은 타구음으로 측정했습니다. 골퍼와 iPhone 사이 거리 1m마다 소리가 전달되는 데 약 3ms가 더해집니다.
Impact timed from the impact sound. Soun.ja: インパクトは打球音から計時しました。あなたとiPhoneの距離1メートルごとに、音が届くまで約3ミリ秒かかります。
Impact timed from the impact sound. Soun.zh-Hans: 击球时刻由击球声测定。你与 iPhone 之间每相距 1 米，声音传播约增加 3 毫秒。
Impact timed from the impact sound. Soun.zh-Hant: 擊球時刻由擊球聲測定。你與 iPhone 之間每相距 1 公尺，聲音傳播約增加 3 毫秒。
Impact timed from the impact sound. Soun.es: El impacto se midió por el sonido del golpe. La propagación del sonido añade unos 3 ms por cada metro entre tú y el iPhone.
Impact timed from the impact sound. Soun.pt-BR: O impacto foi cronometrado pelo som da batida. A propagação do som acrescenta cerca de 3 ms por metro entre você e o iPhone.
Impact timed from the impact sound. Soun.de: Der Treffmoment wurde aus dem Schlaggeräusch bestimmt. Die Schalllaufzeit fügt etwa 3 ms pro Meter zwischen dir und dem iPhone hinzu.
Impact timed from the impact sound. Soun.fr: L’impact a été chronométré d’après le son de frappe. La propagation du son ajoute environ 3 ms par mètre entre vous et l’iPhone.
Impact timed from the impact sound. Soun.it: L’impatto è stato misurato dal suono del colpo. La propagazione del suono aggiunge circa 3 ms per ogni metro tra te e l’iPhone.
Impact timed from the impact sound. Soun.th: จับเวลาจังหวะกระทบจากเสียงตีลูก การเดินทางของเสียงเพิ่มเวลาประมาณ 3 มิลลิวินาทีต่อระยะ 1 เมตรระหว่างคุณกับ iPhone
Impact timed from the impact sound. Soun.vi: Thời điểm chạm bóng được đo từ tiếng đánh bóng. Âm thanh truyền đi cộng thêm khoảng 3 ms cho mỗi mét giữa bạn và iPhone.
